parts.part: A toolbar of toggle buttons and groups
parts.tried: At 1280 and 400: Shift+Tab from the document into the toolbar (one Tab stop, role=toolbar), ArrowRight/ArrowLeft/Home/End over all 17 controls, Space and Enter on Bold, Italic, Heading 2/3, Numbered/Bulleted list, Align left/centre/right, Clear formatting, Undo, Redo, with a selection in the document; read aria-pressed / aria-checked and the document's HTML after each. Every press changed the document and the pressed state, the selection was kept, the focus went to the document and Shift+Tab came back to the same button. At 400 the toolbar scrolls sideways and each focused button was scrolled into view, its focus ring inside the toolbar.
failures: Underline reads pressed (aria-pressed=true) whenever the caret is in a link, though the text is not underlined by the mark: Left-arrow into "the docs" link, or a plain click on "shared agenda" -> pressed toggles: Underline, Align left, Link. It should be pressed only for underlined text.

Heading and List groups are role=radiogroup with role=radio buttons, but Space on the checked radio unchecks it (Heading 3 checked=true -> Space -> checked=false, paragraph). A radio cannot be unchecked; the state announced is not the behaviour. (The builder's log says so too.)
Unsure whether a failure: every press in the toolbar moves the focus to the document, so a second toggle needs Shift+Tab again each time (it does return to the same button).
could_not_exercise: Touch scrolling of the toolbar at 400 (no touch device emulated); only keyboard focus scrolling and the mouse were tried.

parts.tried: At 1280 and 400: Shift+Tab to the menu row (one Tab stop, arrows between File/Edit/Insert/Format), opened each with Enter, Space and ArrowDown, walked every item with ArrowDown (wraps), opened every submenu with ArrowRight and Enter, closed with ArrowLeft and Escape (only the submenu closes; Escape again returns focus to the menu button). Ran by Enter: File > Save, Export > HTML and Plain text (two downloads), Copy as plain text (clipboard read back, snackbar), Print (window.print stubbed, called once); Edit > Undo, Redo, Select all, Clear formatting, Search commands…; Insert > Link…, Horizontal rule, Date and time > Today's date, Current time; Format > Text > Bold, Strikethrough, Paragraph style > Heading 3, Paragraph (menuitemradio, aria-checked follows the caret), List > Numbered list, Align > Right, Left. All applied to the document's selection and ended with the focus in the document (or on the menu button for Save/Export/Copy/Print).
failures: At 400 wide the submenus Format > Text, Format > Paragraph style, Format > List and Insert > Date and time open to the left of the window: ArrowRight on "Text" -> the submenu sits at left = -86px (Paragraph style -70, List -63, Date and time -5), so the focused item's icon and label are cut off ("Bold" is not readable, only "Ctrl+B"; "Strikethrough" shows as "ethrough"). They should be drawn inside the window. Format > Align and File > Export fit.

Stuck tooltip (headless Chromium, keyboard focus only; a mouse hover never left one; why it sticks: unsure): when Tab or Shift+Tab takes the focus out of the Formatting toolbar, or a toolbar press sends the focus to the document, the tooltip of the button left often stays in the DOM for good as [role=tooltip][data-exiting] at opacity 0 with no animation running (seen for Undo, Bold, Italic, Clear formatting; still there 10 s later; it goes when the toolbar is entered and left again by Shift+Tab). While one is stuck, every menu command runs about 1.5 s after Enter instead of at once (Format > Text > Italic: 52 ms clean, 1553 / 1508 / 1552 ms with a stuck tooltip; File > Export > HTML downloaded about 1.5 s late), the focus sitting on the menu button meanwhile and then jumping to the document. Keys pressed in that 1.5 s go to the menu button.
Unsure (drawing only): a row's shortcut touches its label where the row is tight: "Clear formattingCtrl+\" in Format, "ParagraphCtrl+Alt+0" when it carries the check.
could_not_exercise: The real print dialog (window.print was replaced by a counter).
The clipboard refusal path of Copy as plain text (clipboard permission was granted).

parts.tried: At 1280 ("Save" label) and 400 (icon only, aria-label "Save"): Tab to Save, Enter and Space -> status "Saving…" then "Saved" and a "Document saved" snackbar, focus stays on Save. Tab to "More ways to save and export" (aria-haspopup, aria-expanded), opened with Enter, Space, ArrowDown; Escape returns focus to it; ran Export as HTML, Export as plain text (downloads planning-notes.html / .txt), Copy as plain text (clipboard read back, snackbar), Print (stub called); focus returned to the trailing button each time; the menu stays inside the window at 400.

Keyboard focus on each of the 17 toolbar buttons at 1280 and 400, and a mouse hover on each: read the tooltip's text, its <kbd>, its place in the window and that aria-describedby of the button is the tooltip. All 17 show on hover at both widths and inside the window ("Bold Ctrl+B", "Heading 1 Ctrl+Alt+1", "Insert link Ctrl+Shift+K" / "Edit link" in a link, …; alignment and Text colour carry no shortcut, as built). Escape hides it, focus stays. Then pressed every shortcut shown, in the document at about 200 ms a key: Ctrl+B/I/U, Ctrl+Shift+X, Ctrl+Alt+0..3, Ctrl+Shift+7/8, Ctrl+\, Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+Shift+Z, Ctrl+A, Ctrl+Shift+K, Ctrl+S, Ctrl+K: each did what its tooltip says when the page was entered without Tabbing through the toolbar.
failures: Stuck tooltip (headless Chromium, keyboard focus only; a mouse hover never left one; why it sticks: unsure): when Tab or Shift+Tab takes the focus out of the Formatting toolbar, or a toolbar press sends the focus to the document, the tooltip of the button left often stays in the DOM for good as [role=tooltip][data-exiting] at opacity 0 with no animation running (seen for Undo, Bold, Italic, Clear formatting; still there 10 s later; it goes when the toolbar is entered and left again by Shift+Tab). Repro at 1280 and at 400, at 400 ms a key: load, Tab x6 (search bar, Save, More, File, Undo, Document) -> "Undo Ctrl+Z" tooltip is stuck. Then: type a letter (status "Unsaved changes"), Ctrl+S -> nothing, status stays "Unsaved changes" (should save); Ctrl+K -> nothing, no palette (should open it); the same 10 s later. The screen's own overlayOpen() counts any [data-exiting] element as an open overlay. Entering the document by a mouse click instead: Ctrl+S saves and Ctrl+K opens.

Ctrl+Shift+K, the shortcut the Link tooltip shows, pressed in the document with "Decisions" selected: the dialog opens, type example.org/y, Enter -> a new link "https://example.org/y" is inserted at the very start of the document (inside the h1), and "Decisions" is not linked. It should link the selection (the toolbar's Link button and Insert > Link… do).

At 400, no tooltip on keyboard focus for the buttons whose focus scrolls the toolbar: ArrowRight onto "Bulleted list" (toolbar scrolls 0 -> 267) and onto "Link" (267 -> 457) -> no tooltip after 1.5 s; the neighbours show theirs. Hover shows both.
Unsure (automation speed only): with keys sent with no delay, Ctrl+B right after Ctrl+Shift+ArrowRight collapsed the selection and bolded nothing; at 200-500 ms a key it works.
could_not_exercise: The ⌘ / ⌥ forms of the shortcuts (Linux Chromium: only the Ctrl forms are shown and bound).

parts.part: A colour picker in a popover
parts.tried: At 1280 and 400, with text selected: Shift+Tab to the toolbar, arrows to "Text colour", Enter and Space open the popover (role=dialog "Text colour", aria-expanded=true, inside the window at both widths), Escape closes and returns focus to the button. Tab order: dialog, presets (listbox "Presets"), saturation/brightness area (2D slider), Hue slider, Hex field, Cancel, Apply, and round again. Presets: arrows, Home, Space/Enter select (Grey, Green -> hex and "The colour picked" follow). Area: arrows, Shift+arrow, PageUp, Home change the hex and aria-valuetext. Hue: arrows, PageUp, Home, End. Hex: "zzz" is refused, "#00aa55" + Enter commits. Apply -> <span style="color: rgb(0,170,85)"> on the selection in 2 ms, focus and selection back in the document, the button's bar takes the colour, status "Unsaved changes"; reopened at that colour; Cancel closes with focus on the button; with a collapsed caret the next typed text is coloured. Mouse: click opens, drag in the area, click on the hue track, click a preset, click outside closes (focus to the button).
failures: Unsure: the presets listbox says aria-orientation=vertical while its swatches are in a row; ArrowRight/ArrowLeft move, ArrowDown does nothing.
Unsure: the "Text colour" button's name never says which colour is current (it is drawn only, as the bar under the letter).
could_not_exercise: A touch drag in the colour area and on the hue slider (mouse only).

parts.tried: At 1280 (docked) and 400 (full screen, 400x800, nothing off the window): opened from the search bar with Enter and Space, with Ctrl+K from the document and from the toolbar, and by Edit > Search commands…. Dialog "Search commands", search input with aria-controls, listbox "Commands", groups Format 14 / Insert 4 / Edit 3 / Document 5 = 26 options with their shortcuts; Tab goes input <-> Back only. ArrowDown/Up/Home/End/PageDown move aria-activedescendant and keep it in view; typing "head" leaves 3, "zzzz" shows "No command matches" (Enter then just closes); "sav" + Enter with nothing highlighted runs Save; Escape closes with focus back on the bar (or the document after Ctrl+K), the query cleared on reopen. Ran bold, italic, heading 2, paragraph, bulleted, align centre, clear, undo, rule, today's date, link through it; clicked an option with the mouse. During the 900 ms load Ctrl+K opens it while toolbar and menus are disabled.
failures: Ctrl+K from the document loses the place in the document. Entered by Shift+Tab (no tooltip touched), "Decisions" selected, Ctrl+K, "bold", ArrowDown, Enter -> focus returns to the document but the selection is gone, the caret is at the very start of the h1 and nothing is bold; it should bold "Decisions". With a caret in the first list item, Ctrl+K, "today", Enter -> the date is inserted at the start of the h1 ("November 16, 2026Quarterly planning notes"), not at the caret. Ctrl+K then Escape then typing "ZZ" -> "ZZ" lands at the start of the h1, not where the caret was. Opened by Edit > Search commands…, from the search bar by keyboard, or by a mouse click on the bar, the same command applies to the selection.

Stuck tooltip (headless Chromium, keyboard focus only; a mouse hover never left one; why it sticks: unsure): when Tab or Shift+Tab takes the focus out of the Formatting toolbar, or a toolbar press sends the focus to the document, the tooltip of the button left often stays in the DOM for good as [role=tooltip][data-exiting] at opacity 0 with no animation running (seen for Undo, Bold, Italic, Clear formatting; still there 10 s later; it goes when the toolbar is entered and left again by Shift+Tab). While one is stuck, Ctrl+K does nothing at all, from the document or anywhere (load, Tab x6 into the document, Ctrl+K -> no palette, at 1280 and 400, still 10 s later). That is the plain keyboard way into the document. The bar (Enter) and Edit > Search commands… still open it, and a command chosen then runs about 1.5 s late (italic from the bar: 1548 ms).
Unsure: the empty state "No command matches" is exposed as a role=option in the listbox.
could_not_exercise: The on-screen keyboard over the full-screen layout on a real phone.

parts.part: The editing surface, rich text with headings, lists, links and marks
parts.tried: At 1280 and 400, keyboard only at about 200 ms a key: entered the document (role=textbox, aria-multiline, "Document"; the sheet shows a 3px focus outline), typed a paragraph (word count 106 -> 111, status "Unsaved changes"), Ctrl+Alt+2 + typing -> h2 and Enter gives a p, Ctrl+Shift+8 -> ul with Enter for the next item and Enter Enter to leave it, Ctrl+Shift+7 -> ol, Ctrl+B/I/U and Ctrl+Shift+X while typing -> b/i/u/strike, Ctrl+\ clears them, Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undo and redo. Links by the toolbar's Link button: no selection -> dialog "Insert link" with Text and Address (focus on Address, Tab is trapped, empty Address + Enter -> aria-invalid and "Give the link an address."), filled -> the docs; caret in the link -> Link pressed, tooltip "Edit link", dialog prefilled, new address saved, "Remove link" unlinks; a selected word + mailto: address -> linked; Escape and Cancel return to the document with the selection; Insert > Link… likewise. Tab leaves the surface. Mouse: plain click on a link places the caret, Ctrl+click opened https://example.com/agenda in a new page.
failures: Ctrl+Shift+K in the document with "Decisions" selected, address typed, Enter -> the link is inserted as new text "https://example.org/y" at the start of the h1; the selection is not linked. Ctrl+K from the document does the same to every command (see part 6): an overlay opened by a shortcut from inside the document puts the caret at the document's start when it closes.

The lists the surface makes are nested inside paragraphs, and paragraphs inside paragraphs: Ctrl+Shift+8 in an empty paragraph, two items, Enter Enter, "after list" ->

  • first
  • second

after list

; the toolbar's Numbered list on a paragraph ->

  1. …

. It reads and edits, but Export as HTML writes that markup (invalid HTML). Unsure how much it matters.

Link edits and removals by the toolbar or the menu run about 1.5 s after Enter when a tooltip is stuck (Save of an edited address: 1600 ms; Remove link: 1604 ms; 207 ms clean), the focus on the Link button meanwhile, then jumping to the document: keys typed in between go to the toolbar (see part 4).
Unsure whether within the part: a link can be followed only with Ctrl+click (the footer says so); there is no keyboard way to open the link the caret is in.
could_not_exercise: Spell-check, IME composition and paste of rich content.
Touch selection and a phone's on-screen keyboard.
